name: SEA Monster
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Bartini Bar & Lounge (Babylon) - event calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Identity is solid: the Bartini listing links the band's own site. Only one usable photo: most site photos are under 600 px wide, and some show topless/burlesque dancers on stage, which I skipped on purpose. The logo is the site's header artwork (monster drawing plus band name), not a stand-alone wordmark. YouTube videos are linked from the site but no official channel; no Instagram found. The band's own shows page is empty.
description: A Long Island rock and roll band that mixes punk, psychobilly and blues. Formed in the mid-1980s, it was a regular at New York City punk clubs such as CBGB and still plays its own songs live.

logo.alt: Bright green drawing of a scaly sea monster with the band name Sea Monster in yellow old-style letters

photos.alt: Four members of Sea Monster posing on a club stage under a Continental sign, one holding a red electric guitar

evidence.note: Bartini Bar & Lounge (Babylon) lists its Halloween party on Sat Oct 31 at 7:30 PM 'featuring SEA MONSTER' and points to seamonstermusic.com.
Official site: rock and roll band from Long Island combining punk, psychobilly and blues; first record 1986; house band at CBGB around 1990; links the band's Facebook page.
The band takes messages through a contact form; no public email or phone shown.
